findings: run_pilot_once composes frozen startup/complete-prefix/full-storage acceptance, exact600s process/4MiB log/trajectory allowance, a gated child entry point, independent completed-prefix audit and post-run full remaining storage. It handles one fresh slot and never performs cleanup or advances stages.

The bounded launch record now includes parent PID. The child checks exact reconstructed module arguments, inherited locks, parent identity, all launch limits, full required-free arithmetic and immutable startup provenance. Only fresh launch.json and worker.log may have appeared.

Checkpoint hashing in child preflight must not hold the metadata namespace lock: otherwise the parent monitor can time out while hashing prior gigabyte checkpoints. Hashes now run outside that lock, accepting changes only to the bounded process log; exact evidence file sets and other file hashes remain required. Frozen-plan metadata censuses are serialized against parent publication.

Sampled bounded CPU guards protect controller preparation and child entry before training. Controller cap1800s covers preparation, the unchanged600s child process and post-review; child entry cap600s/4GiB/8GiB. The existing scientific resource recorder additionally enforces MPS driver6GiB and full measurement traces. Successful receipt requires a finite bounded child guard observation and fresh frozen provenance after audits.

Three serial synthetic pilot transitions retained all six tiny checkpoint files, independently reviewed each completed prefix and published no cleanup/stage/adoption authorization. Changed parent/argv/limits/files, missing prerequisites, failed bodies and invalid final guard measurements block progress and retain failures.
A real tiny subprocess exercising only the entry guard exited90 when its synthetic sampled RSS reached4GiB; its bounded durable failure record was retained. No model or MPS was used.

The initial test run had one expectation mismatch: a changed startup hash was rejected by argv validation before the guard record existed. Validation was moved inside the entry guard so that this failure is also durable; the original failed log remains preserved.
limitations: Controller/worker science bodies and the frozen campaign gate are mocked in transition tests. The complete plan gate, audit/storage/process and body component suites were also run; none substitutes for actual nine-case numerical or measured pilot evidence.

No parent campaign run CLI or plan-freezing command is provided. Caller must inspect actual processes and own both shared locks throughout run_pilot_once. There is no resume or retry path for a pending, failed or completed slot.

Versioned full-stage cleanup/selection/quality/inference orchestration and actual nine rank-policy optimizer/update/resume/EMA/input/measured-pilot prerequisites remain. The failed combined numerical fixture stays closed; no real MPS launch or retry was made.

Actual storage observations fluctuated around the unchanged full-panel threshold during this bounded preparation. A near-threshold reading is not durable launch capacity; the full gate must be rechecked at every actual transition. No research checkpoints or unrelated files were removed.
Historical closed controllers, holdout boundaries, scientific rates/seeds/order/rank choice and all selection thresholds remain unchanged.
